title: The State of Law Firm Websites 2026
note: Aggregates computed from automated scans. No individual site is identified.
attribution: Free to use and cite under CC BY 4.0. Credit Clikiti with a link.
citation: Clikiti. (2026, October 12). The state of law firm websites 2026 (Q4 2026) [Report]. https://clikiti.com/research/law/2026-q4
audience: Web agencies and freelancers selling to small law firms and solo practitioners
findings: Only 39% of the 125 small law firm websites we scanned pair a tappable phone number with office hours, 24/7 availability or a response time.
A typical site answers four of the eight questions clients ask before choosing (mean 4.3).
The median overall score is 76 out of 100 (mean 77).
The least-answered questions are "Can I reach someone now?" (39%), "Are they licensed here?" (43%) and "Do clients vouch for them?" (45%).
The best-answered are "Do they handle my kind of case?" (91%) and "Who will handle my case?" (63%).
Small business and employment have the highest median score (79), against 77 for personal injury, 77 for criminal defence and immigration and 75 for family and estate.
68% fail "Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone" (Core Web Vitals · LCP).
42% fail "LegalService or Attorney structured data" (Schema.org · LegalService).
Personal injury firms state a consultation cost more often than business firms.
Practice groups differ in median score by at least 3 points.

technical.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone

agencyProblems.label: Text contrast passes 4.5:1
agencyProblems.fix: Raise text contrast to at least 4.5:1 in the theme.
agencyProblems.pitch: Parts of the site are hard to read, and it is a WCAG failure.

agencyProblems.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone
agencyProblems.fix: Resize and compress the hero image, defer scripts, aim for under 2.5 s on a phone.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your home page takes several seconds to appear on the phone of someone who needs help now.

agencyProblems.label: Tappable phone plus hours or response time
agencyProblems.question: Can I reach someone now?
agencyProblems.fix: A tappable phone number in the header, with office hours or a stated response time beside it.
agencyProblems.pitch: Someone who needs a lawyer tonight cannot tell from your site whether anyone will answer.

agencyProblems.label: Bar admission or licence stated
agencyProblems.question: Are they licensed here?
agencyProblems.fix: State on each lawyer's page where they are admitted or licensed to practise, and since when.
agencyProblems.pitch: The first thing a careful client checks is whether you can practise in their state, and the site never says.

agencyProblems.label: Reviews marked up or shown in a widget
agencyProblems.question: Do clients vouch for them?
agencyProblems.fix: Show the firm's client reviews on the site, with Review or AggregateRating markup.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your clients already praise you elsewhere. Your own site does not show it.
